additional_info.body:
Dear Nikolaos.
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
Following your report, we checked the logs on the given timestamp  (28-01-2026, 12:22), but we didn`t see any authentication trying to start on the charger, also no errors are showing.
We do see around that timestamp the connection of the charger got lost a few times, which can have effect on the charger working or authenticating properly.
We do see that right now the charger is in a healthy and stable state.
Please let us know if you are still facing issues with this problem.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
